description.content: Data-driven collection for POST /api/checkout, driven by test-data.csv. Item 1 is a one-time fixture (runs only on iteration 0): provisions fresh User B / User C accounts, logs in User A, and snapshots User A's baseline order count. Item 2 is the data-driven checkout request; per-row execution shape (cart seeding, auth-header construction, wire-mutation, cross-actor isolation, cross-response analysis) is resolved entirely in its own pre-request script. See homeworks/HW06/artifacts/test-cases/fr-08-checkout/audit/audited-master-test-cases.md for the audited case source.
